summary: NVIDIA 发布硬件蓝图，研究聚焦多智能体情感与安全。机器人实测暴露落地鸿沟，效率远逊人类。技术正向具身智能与可信评估演进。

news.title: NVIDIA Rubin Platform, Open Models, Autonomous Driving: NVIDIA Presents Blueprint for the Future at CES
news.comment: NVIDIA 发布 Rubin 平台蓝图，涵盖开源模型与自动驾驶，定义下一代 AI 基础设施。

news.title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study
news.comment: 提出 E-STEER 框架，实现情绪隐藏层直接干预，探索机制性影响，具研究价值。

news.title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction
news.comment: 提出动态多智能体面板 CAMP，引入三值投票，解决临床预测异质性，提升可靠性。

news.title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
news.comment: 聚焦智能体工具可靠性瓶颈，社区驱动标准化框架，含自动化测试，落地价值高。

news.title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation
news.comment: 多智能体协作框架，专攻行为健康对话，强化安全审计与角色分工，具高落地参考价值。

news.title: Dynin-Omni: Omnimodal Unified Large Diffusion Language Model
news.comment: 首创掩码扩散全模态架构，统一文本图像语音视频，非自回归路径值得关注。

news.title: How Trustworthy Are LLM-as-Judge Ratings for Interpretive Responses? Implications for Qualitative Research Workflows
news.comment: 探究 LLM 评判定性回复的可靠性，填补评估空白，为社科研究 AI 工作流提供关键参考。

news.title: [R] Is autoresearch really better than classic hyperparameter tuning?
news.comment: AutoResearch 调优优于 Optuna，效率更高，LLM 应用值得关注

news.title: [P] PhAIL (phail.ai) – an open benchmark for robot AI on real hardware. Best model: 5% of human throughput, needs help every 4 minutes.
news.comment: 真实硬件基准测试，揭露 VLA 模型实际产能仅为人类 5%，数据诚实极具参考价值。

news.title: The Download: gig workers training humanoids, and better AI benchmarks
news.comment: 揭示人形机器人远程训练新模式，关注 AI 背后的人力环节与基准测试改进。
